counterfactual_missing_items: no visible mass or ulceration in the upper aerodigestive tract
decisive_items: a protruding lesion was observed through the right palatine tonsil; it was hard, mobile, well-delineated, nontender, and yellowish-white in color
a uniform, ovoid calcification overlying the right tonsillar region abutting the mandibular ramus
response.rationale: R2 is directly supported by the lesion's hard, mobile, well-delineated, yellowish-white nature and the uniform ovoid calcification on radiograph, which are pathognomonic for tonsillolith. R3 relies only on risk factors (tobacco, betel-nut) but lacks any visible mass or ulceration, and the imaging shows calcification rather than a soft-tissue tumor, making it a poor fit.

rejected.why: Only risk factors are present; no mucosal lesion or ulceration, and imaging shows calcification not a mass, contradicting squamous cell carcinoma.
